name: Elemental Marksman (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): One Elemental Flux maneuver known.

Benefit(s): When you hit a foe with a maneuver using a weapon that deals the same type of damage as your active energy type (such as with a laser pistol while your active energy type is fire), the creature must succeed at two saving throws against the maneuver instead of one.
